title: Fix external storage migration for unsafe attachment filenames
summary: Fix external storage migration of document attachments with unsafe filenames by sanitizing paths while retaining uniqueness and preserving displayed names.
key_points: Filenames like 'Invoice Nov'25.pdf' that violate storage validation are now sanitized without changing displayed File Name or extension
Failed attachment synchronizations are isolated and roll back individual steps while processing continues
Remote deletion calls are eliminated; worker explicitly uses RetireExternalReference for local reference retirement only
Failed attachments are registered locally and can be recovered; interactive and background runs handle errors differently
Added extensive test coverage for restored, external-only, and stale file scenarios
quote: Sanitize generated storage/media-import filenames without changing displayed File Name or File Extension.
